basic_info.description: Come see this Parkside beauty positioned perfectly in the heart of the Sunset! This striking home has a unique way of standing out on an extra wide street. The main floor welcomes you warmly with its abundance of natural light. And the spacious living room, equipped with a fireplace, flows easily into the dining space and kitchen. 2BD/1 BA upstairs, plus a bonus 1 BA and 1 BA downstairs. Equipped with a deep garage and a charming yard ready to be customized. Fantastic location, just steps away from Sunset Reservoir where you can enjoy commanding views of the entire western region of San Francisco - spanning all of Sunset, Ocean Beach, and the iconic Golden Gate Bridge! The perfect way to clear your mind and soak in miles of endless views.
